user.title: WashData Setup
user.description:
Set up a washing machine or other appliance. A power sensor is required.

After setup, open the WashData panel from the sidebar ([/ha-washdata](/ha-washdata)) to see cycles, profiles and all settings.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this device (e.g., 'Washing Machine', 'Dishwasher').
data_description.device_type: Sets detection defaults for this kind of appliance.
data_description.power_sensor: The smart plug's power sensor (W or kW), not its energy counter (kWh).
data_description.min_power: Readings above this (in watts) mean the appliance is running. 2 W suits most devices.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WashData
reconfigure.description:
Change the device name, appliance type or power sensor.

Everything else is in the WashData panel (sidebar, or [/ha-washdata](/ha-washdata)).

error.invalid_power: Power threshold must be greater than 0
error.power_sensor_energy: This is an energy counter (kWh), not a power sensor. Pick the plug's power sensor (W or kW). If the plug has none, a Derivative helper can make one from the counter.

init.title: WashData Settings
init.description: Rename the device or change its core settings. Everything else is in the [WashData panel](/ha-washdata) in the sidebar.

error.invalid_power: Power threshold must be greater than 0
error.timer_pause_body_suffix: The cycle is paused. Open the WashData panel to resume.
error.power_sensor_energy: This is an energy counter (kWh), not a power sensor. Pick the plug's power sensor (W or kW). If the plug has none, a Derivative helper can make one from the counter.

extra_fields_descriptions.program: Only this program, by its exact name. Leave empty for any program.
extra_fields_descriptions.phase: Only this phase, by its name. Leave empty for any phase.
extra_fields_descriptions.minutes: Finishing soon: minutes left. Still tumbling: minutes after the finish.
extra_fields_descriptions.percent: Percent over the program's usual duration.
extra_fields_descriptions.include_detected: Also trigger on pauses WashData sees in the power, such as a soak or a stall.
extra_fields_descriptions.status: Only cycles that ended this way.
extra_fields_descriptions.from: Only changes from this state. Leave empty for any.
extra_fields_descriptions.to: Only changes to this state. Leave empty for any.
extra_fields_descriptions.task: Only this task, by its name or id. Leave empty for any task.

label_cycle.name: Label Cycle
label_cycle.description: Assign an existing profile to a past cycle, or remove the label.

cycle_id.name: Cycle ID
cycle_id.description: The ID of the cycle to label.

profile_name.name: Profile Name
profile_name.description: An existing profile name (create profiles in the WashData panel). Leave blank to remove the label.

create_profile.name: Create Profile
create_profile.description: Create a new profile (standalone or based on a reference cycle).

profile_name.name: Profile Name
profile_name.description: Name for the new profile (e.g. 'Heavy Duty', 'Delicates').

reference_cycle_id.name: Reference Cycle ID
reference_cycle_id.description: Optional cycle ID to base this profile on.

delete_profile.name: Delete Profile
delete_profile.description: Delete a profile and optionally unlabel cycles using it.

unlabel_cycles.name: Unlabel Cycles
unlabel_cycles.description: Remove profile label from cycles using this profile.

auto_label_cycles.name: Auto-Label Old Cycles
auto_label_cycles.description: Retroactively label unlabeled cycles using profile matching.

confidence_threshold.name: Confidence Threshold
confidence_threshold.description: Minimum match confidence (0.50-0.95) to apply labels. Leave empty to use the device's Auto-Label Confidence setting.

export_config.name: Export Config
export_config.description: Export this device's profiles, cycles and settings to a JSON file.

path.name: Path
path.description: Optional absolute file path to write (defaults to /config/ha_washdata_export_{entry}.json).

import_config.name: Import Config
import_config.description: Import profiles, cycles, and settings for this device from a JSON export file (settings may be overwritten).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The WashData device to import into.

path.name: Path
path.description: Absolute path to the export JSON file to import.

submit_cycle_feedback.name: Submit Cycle Feedback
submit_cycle_feedback.description: Confirm or correct the detected program of a finished cycle. Give `device_id` (recommended) or `entry_id`.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The WashData device (recommended instead of entry_id).

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: The config entry id for the device (alternative to device_id).

cycle_id.name: Cycle ID
cycle_id.description: The cycle id shown in the feedback notification / logs.

user_confirmed.name: Confirm Detected Program
user_confirmed.description: Set true if the detected program is correct.

corrected_profile.name: Corrected Profile
corrected_profile.description: If not confirmed, provide the correct profile/program name.

record_start.name: Record Cycle Start
record_start.description: Start manually recording a clean cycle (bypasses all matching logic).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The WashData device to stop recording.

trim_cycle.name: Trim Cycle
trim_cycle.description: Trim the power data of a past cycle to a specific time window.

cycle_id.name: Cycle ID
cycle_id.description: The ID of the cycle to trim.

trim_start_s.name: Trim Start (seconds)
trim_start_s.description: Keep data from this offset in seconds. Default 0.

trim_end_s.name: Trim End (seconds)
trim_end_s.description: Keep data up to this offset in seconds. Default = full duration.

pause_cycle.name: Pause Cycle
pause_cycle.description: Pause the active cycle for a WashData device.

resume_cycle.name: Resume Cycle
resume_cycle.description: Resume a paused cycle for a WashData device.

trigger_ml_training.name: Trigger ML Training
trigger_ml_training.description: Manually retrain the on-device ML models from this device's own labelled cycles (experimental).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The WashData device to retrain models for.

mark_unloaded.name: Mark Unloaded
mark_unloaded.description: Confirm the finished load was taken out. Clears the Clean state and any unload reminder.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The WashData device whose finished load has been taken out.

cycle_started.name: Cycle started
cycle_started.description: Triggers when the appliance starts a cycle.

program_recognised.name: Program recognised
program_recognised.description: Triggers when WashData recognises the running cycle's program, or switches it to another program.

program.name: Program
program.description: Only this program, by its exact name. Leave empty for any program.

phase_started.name: Phase started
phase_started.description: Triggers when the running cycle enters a new phase of its program.

phase.name: Phase
phase.description: Only this phase, by its name. Leave empty for any phase.

finishing_soon.name: Finishing soon
finishing_soon.description: Triggers once per cycle, when the time remaining first drops to this many minutes.

minutes.name: Minutes left
minutes.description: Trigger when this many minutes or fewer are left.

cycle_overrun.name: Cycle running long
cycle_overrun.description: Triggers once per cycle, when it runs this much longer than its program usually takes.

percent.name: Longer by
percent.description: Percent over the program's usual duration.

cycle_paused.name: Cycle paused
cycle_paused.description: Triggers when you pause a cycle, and optionally when the appliance pauses on its own.

include_detected.name: Include detected pauses
include_detected.description: Also trigger on pauses WashData sees in the power, such as a soak or a stall, not only on pauses you start.

cycle_resumed.name: Cycle resumed
cycle_resumed.description: Triggers when a paused cycle continues.

include_detected.name: Include detected pauses
include_detected.description: Also trigger on pauses WashData sees in the power, such as a soak or a stall, not only on pauses you start.

cycle_stalled.name: Cycle stalled
cycle_stalled.description: Triggers when a running cycle halts at a low, flat power level.

cycle_finished.name: Cycle finished
cycle_finished.description: Triggers when a cycle finishes, also when you stop it. Not for a false start.

program.name: Program
program.description: Only this program, by its exact name. Leave empty for any program.

cycle_ended.name: Cycle ended
cycle_ended.description: Triggers when a cycle ends for any reason, false starts included.

status.name: Ended as
status.description: Only cycles that ended this way.

anti_wrinkle_started.name: Anti-wrinkle started
anti_wrinkle_started.description: Triggers when the appliance starts tumbling the finished load against creases.

still_tumbling.name: Still tumbling after the cycle
still_tumbling.description: Triggers once when the appliance still tumbles in short bursts this many minutes after the cycle finished. Stops at a new cycle or 4 hours after the finish.

minutes.name: Minutes after the finish
minutes.description: Trigger at the first tumble at least this long after the finish.

unload_pending.name: Unload pending
unload_pending.description: Triggers when a cycle finished and the load is still inside.

unloaded.name: Unloaded
unloaded.description: Triggers when the load is taken out after a cycle: the door opened or the unload was confirmed.

state_changed.name: State changed
state_changed.description: Triggers when the WashData state changes.

from.name: From
from.description: Only changes from this state. Leave empty for any.

to.name: To
to.description: Only changes to this state. Leave empty for any.

maintenance_due.name: Maintenance due
maintenance_due.description: Triggers when a maintenance task becomes due.

task.name: Task
task.description: Only this task, by its name or id. Leave empty for any task.

milestone_reached.name: Cycle milestone reached
milestone_reached.description: Triggers when the lifetime cycle count reaches one of the milestones set for notifications.

pump_stuck.name: Pump stuck
pump_stuck.description: Triggers when a pump runs longer than its stuck limit.

no_config_entry.message: No config entry found for device.

integration_not_loaded.message: Integration not loaded for this device.

cycle_not_found_or_no_power.message: Cycle not found or has no power data.

trim_failed_empty_window.message: Trim failed - cycle not found, no power data, or resulting window is empty.

trim_invalid_range.message: trim_end_s must be greater than trim_start_s.

no_active_cycle.message: No active cycle to pause or resume.

path_not_allowed.message: Path is not allowed: {path}. Add its directory to 'allowlist_external_dirs' in configuration.yaml.

export_path_exists.message: Export target already exists: {path}. Choose a different path or remove the existing file first.
